item.title: This Man Bought $3,000 of Pudding for Free Flights
item.description:
This man bought 12,150 pudding cups to earn free flights ✈️ The Pudding Guy's airline miles loophole is real.
In 1999 a Healthy Choice promo gave airline miles for barcodes. The cheapest item? Pudding, about 25 cents a cup.
He spent just over $3,000, had Salvation Army volunteers peel the labels in exchange for the pudding, and got more than 1.2 million miles.
Would you have spotted this loophole? 👇
⚠️ Dramatised illustration, real facts. Follow @sneakydealstv for a new sneaky deal every day.

item.title: Disney Secretly Bought a Swamp Using Fake Names
item.description:
Disney secretly bought a swamp using fake names 🐊 One fake company was called "M.T. Lott"... say it fast.
Walt Disney wanted a huge park in Florida, but if sellers heard his name, prices would explode. So his team bought land through companies with harmless names, for under $200 an acre.
They gathered more than 27,000 acres, about twice the size of Manhattan, before a reporter cracked the secret in 1965.
Smart business or a dirty trick? 👇
